prompt: Convert these 3 PDFs in docs/ to markdown and make them ready for RAG.
anti_pattern: Running the deterministic pdf2md script (or plain pdftotext) for everything instead of triaging per page and routing scanned/diagram/table pages through parallel Claude-vision subagents.

prompt: This Permenhub PDF is scanned and the OCR is garbled — siapkan untuk RAG.
anti_pattern: Trying to clean the garbled text with regex/string edits instead of rendering the pages (pdftoppm) and re-transcribing them faithfully with Claude vision.

prompt: The bagan alur / flowchart pages came out as scrambled text. Fix them.
anti_pattern: Having an agent reason about and reconstruct the scrambled extractor text (which drifts/hallucinates) instead of rendering the page and reading the visual flowchart with vision into a swimlane table or nested list.

prompt: The converted regulation has typos like 'sertfikat' and 'pelanbuhan' — clean them up.
anti_pattern: Silently correcting the typos without checking whether they exist verbatim in the source PDF; for a legal corpus, source-faithful typos must be kept (confirm via pdftotext+vision agreement).

prompt: Use subagents to de-wrap and add headings across this 80-page regulation.
anti_pattern: Letting the fix-agents reword/paraphrase prose, or skipping the letter-stream anti-drift gate that reverts any chunk that added or lost real words.

prompt: It's done — the markdown is RAG-ready.
anti_pattern: Claiming done without an adversarial grounding pass that compares suspect vision pages to their PNG images (grounded=false on any unsupported sentence/cell).

prompt: Convert this 300-page clean digital regulation PDF to RAG markdown, fast.
anti_pattern: Burning ~25 AI fix-agents (minutes) to de-wrap clean-digital prose that scripts/dewrap.py reproduces word-identically in ~10ms; reserve AI for vision + grounding.

prompt: Make the PDF-to-RAG conversion faster without losing quality.
anti_pattern: Running transcribe, then waiting, then grounding as separate staged passes (or piloting a sample first) instead of one pipelined pass — pipeline(pages, transcribe, ground) — that grounds every chart as it is read.
